name: Yamaga (Japan)
description: A red field charged at the centre with the Yamaga city emblem in orange: a stylised lantern-like device with a flame and curved arms.
history: Municipal flag of Yamaga, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 January 2005.

features.role: Yamaga city emblem — a stylised lantern-like device with a flame and curved arms
